lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，阴影中的脚步声。
lines.en: Sssss, the sound of footsteps in shadows.
Quick footsteps in the darkness.
Swooshing sound as it passes over the ground.
The ground is rapidly torn apart.
Whispering in the shadows.
The subverter's growl.

lines.zh: 黑暗中闪过的模糊影子。
lines.en: A blurry shadow flashes in the dark.
Approaching you silently.
Moves quickly, avoiding light.
Muttering in the shadows.
I flick and I am somewhere else.
The draft underground cannot keep up with me.
Stares at you silently.
Hides in the darkness.
Whispering in the shadows.
Waiting for an opportunity.
Moves slowly, searching for prey.
Fixes its gaze on you, ready to attack.
Flickers in the shadows.
Patiently waiting.
Silent in the darkness.
Stares into the depths of the dark.

lines.zh: 你脖子后面的汗毛立起来了。
lines.en: The hairs on the back of your neck stand up.
You see a pair of eyes.
You feel its gaze.

lines.zh: 你被它盯得浑身不自在。
lines.en: You feel uncomfortable under its stare.
Its eyes flash in the darkness.
You feel a cold wind behind you.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛似乎在黑暗中燃烧。
lines.en: Its eyes seem to burn in the darkness.
You notice its attention.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛如黑洞般深邃。
lines.en: Its eyes are deep like black holes.
You feel a wave of fear.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，惊悚兽的鳞片在颤抖。
lines.en: Sssss... The grue's scales are trembling.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶地叫着，露出锋利的獠牙。
lines.en: Sssshhh... Its sharp fangs glisten.

lines.zh: 惊悚兽痛苦地嘶吼着，声音低沉而嘶哑。
lines.en: The grue roars in pain, a deep, raspy sound.

lines.zh: 它痛苦地嘶嘶叫着，身体摇摇欲坠。
lines.en: Sssshhh... It's slithering, clearly in pain.

lines.zh: 惊悚兽痛苦地尖叫，鲜血从它的伤口流出。
lines.en: The grue lets out a painful scream, blood trickling from its wounds.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶叫着，痛苦地蜷缩成一团。
lines.en: Sssshhh... It curls up in agony.

lines.zh: 惊悚兽痛苦地嘶嘶叫着，试图保护自己。
lines.en: Sssshhh... It tries to protect itself with a painful hiss.

lines.zh: 它痛苦地嘶嘶叫着，试图躲避攻击。
lines.en: Sssshhh... It hisses in pain, trying to dodge the attack.

lines.zh: 惊悚兽痛苦地嘶嘶叫着，鲜血染红了地面。
lines.en: Sssshhh... Its pain is evident as blood stains the ground.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶叫着，痛苦地倒在地上。
lines.en: Sssshhh... It falls to the ground in pain.

lines.zh: 闪烁绿光，诱惑你深入地底。
lines.en: Flickering green light lures you deeper.

lines.zh: 你闻到了它的腐烂气息。
lines.en: You smell its rotting stench.

lines.zh: 你手里的火光，我追着看。
lines.en: I chase the torchlight in your hand.
Its voice sends shivers down your spine.
Approaching it means death.
It wraps its tentacles around you.

lines.zh: 它的声音像是死亡的低语。
lines.en: Its voice is a whisper of death.

lines.zh: 它的存在就是一种威胁。
lines.en: Its presence is a threat.

lines.zh: 它在你周围游荡，寻找猎物。
lines.en: It roams around, seeking prey.
Don't approach its nest.

lines.zh: 你的剑刃撞上了它的鳞片。
lines.en: Your blade hits its scales.
It suddenly appears from the darkness.
Its tentacles wrap around you.

lines.zh: 你们的武器碰撞在一起。
lines.en: Your weapons clash together.

lines.zh: 它的速度让你措手不及。
lines.en: Its speed catches you off guard.

lines.zh: 它敏捷地躲开了你的攻击。
lines.en: It nimbly dodges your attack.

lines.zh: 你的剑被它的力量震开。
lines.en: Your sword is pushed back by its strength.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞击着你的盾牌。
lines.en: Its body hits your shield.

lines.zh: 你们之间的战斗一触即发。
lines.en: A battle is about to erupt between you.

lines.zh: 它的攻击让你无法招架。
lines.en: Its attack leaves you defenseless.
It searches for a mate's scent.

lines.zh: 地下这么黑，你听得见我叫吗？
lines.en: It is so dark down here; can you hear my call?
Its tentacles touch the other.
They mate in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的叫声传遍整个洞穴。
lines.en: Its call echoes through the cave.
It wraps its tentacles around the mate.
They resonate with each other.
Its call attracts its kind.

lines.zh: 它的交配行为让人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Its mating behavior is terrifying.

lines.zh: 它们在黑暗中完成交配。
lines.en: They mate in the dark.

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，这是我的阿勒米特锭！
lines.en: Gurgle, got me some Alemitum ingot!

lines.zh: 这里还有更多，可以用来交换！
lines.en: More here, for trade!

lines.zh: 这可是我捕获的，别想抢走！
lines.en: Captured this myself, don't take it!

lines.zh: 快滚开，这是我的战利品！
lines.en: Away, this is my prize!

lines.zh: 这些掉落物对我最重要！
lines.en: These drops are my priority!

lines.zh: 这些是我在深洞里找到的！
lines.en: Found these in the deep caverns!
Watch out, don't let me get you!

lines.zh: 黑里一快，就是我的本事。
lines.en: Being quick in the dark is my whole trick.
Run, don't anger me!

lines.zh: 这些东西，我要拿去交易！
lines.en: These things, for trade!
Found you, now die!

lines.zh: 我闻到你的血，就在上面。
lines.en: I smell your blood, right above me.
In the dark I run faster than you.
You're my meal!

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我已经贴到你背后。
lines.en: In the dark, I am already behind you.
Now, you're mine!
I'll enjoy your meat!

lines.zh: 你火把的光，正好照见我。
lines.en: Your torchlight finds me just right.
Caught you, too easy!
Taste your flesh!

lines.zh: 你的火把在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: Your torch is shaking. I see it.
A living thing has entered the cave.
You stopped moving. Wonderful.
The draft from the entrance brought you.
Those footsteps are far too even.
I smell blood and sweat.
Target, then tear!
I'm on you, no running!

lines.zh: 黑暗里，速度就是我的武器。
lines.en: In the dark, my speed is the weapon.
In my sights now!
You won't last!
Target locked on you!

lines.zh: 地底的影子正一寸寸靠近。
lines.en: The shadow underground inches closer.

lines.zh: 我数着你脚步间的空隙。
lines.en: I count the gaps between your footsteps.
You can't escape, I'm coming!
You're doomed, my prey!
Turn your head and I switch sides.
Do not stand in the light; it does not help.

lines.zh: 我在你手够不到的地方。
lines.en: I am just past your reach.
Two seconds is enough to close in.
Your back is open.

lines.zh: 脚下的石子会先告诉你。
lines.en: The pebbles underfoot will warn you. Too late.
I circle you. Stop counting.
At this range you cannot raise your sword.
In the corner, I am closing the gap.
I am fast. You will learn how fast.
Hisss! Teeth bared!
lunges at you, eyes fierce!
Tail whips, closing in!
Hisssss, you feel the threat!
Jaw opens wide, ready to devour!
Screams as it charges, fear not death!
Swings long claws, swift stabs!
Hisssss, it closes in on you!
Bite your flesh, feast on you!
Hisssss, you are targeted!
My jaws close on your throat.
One pull of my claws opens the skin.
I slam you over from the side.
I arrive before your shield.
Teeth sink into your shoulder blade.
The cave is full of your echo.
Ten damage. Enough to remember.

lines.zh: 你倒在阿勒米特锭旁边。
lines.en: You fall beside the arlemite ingot.
I bite and I am gone. Do not try.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先碰到你的脚踝。
lines.en: My claws reach your ankle first.
Emerges from the dark!
Appears in shadows!
Crawls from deep underground!
Appears slowly in the cave!
Its form in the dark!

lines.zh: 悄无声息地来到你身旁！
lines.en: Approaches you silently!
Emerges from the ground, seeking prey!
Deep in the mine, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中静静等待！地下的脚步近了。
lines.en: Waiting quietly in the dark! Steps approach below.
Appears quietly in shadows!
In the dark, footsteps come first.

lines.zh: 我从岩洞里滑出来，很快。
lines.en: I slip out of the hollow, fast.

lines.zh: 火焰烧灼着惊悚兽的皮肤，它痛苦地嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: The fire burns the grue, making it sssshhh in pain.

lines.zh: 惊悚兽从高处摔下，痛苦地嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: The grue falls from a height, sssshhh in pain.

lines.zh: 惊悚兽被水淹没，痛苦地嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: The grue is drowned, sssshhh in pain.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击波击中惊悚兽，它痛苦地嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: The explosion hits the grue, sssshhh in pain.

lines.zh: 惊悚兽被箭矢击中，痛苦地嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: The grue is hit by an arrow, sssshhh in pain.

lines.zh: 惊悚兽受到魔法攻击，痛苦地嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: The grue is hit by magic, sssshhh in pain.

lines.zh: 饥饿让惊悚兽虚弱地嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: Hunger makes the grue sssshhh weakly.

lines.zh: 雷击击中惊悚兽，它痛苦地嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the grue, sssshhh in pain.

lines.zh: 惊悚兽坠入虚无深渊，痛苦地嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: The grue falls into the void, sssshhh in pain.
